overview.name: iShares Bitcoin Premium Income ETF
overview.description: The shares are intended to constitute a simple means of making an investment similar to an investment in bitcoin, while providing premium income by selling monthly call options. A strategy of holding an asset or basket of assets and selling call options that reference the asset or basket of assets is commonly known as a “covered call” or “buy-write” strategy.
